# py-store

> Lightweight multi-backend data layer for Python asyncio: pure JSON schemas plus a MongoDB-style GQL tree query dialect that runs on MongoDB, MySQL, SQLite and PostgreSQL, with built-in role-based access control, computed columns and soft-delete.

`py-store` lets a Python service define a model once as a dict and query it with a single dialect across MongoDB (native aggregation, PyMongo `AsyncMongoClient`) and MySQL / PostgreSQL / SQLite (parameterized SQL). Nested relations compile to one native query per backend. It is the Python host over the shared Rust engine [`rust-store`](https://github.com/coenddt/rust-store) ([Gitee](https://gitee.com/coenddt/rust-store)) (binding: `rust-store-py`); its Node.js twin is [`nodejs-store`](https://github.com/coenddt/nodejs-store) ([Gitee](https://gitee.com/coenddt/nodejs-store)).

- PyPI distribution name: `storepy` — import package: `py_store` (`pip install storepy`, `from py_store import init, store`)
- Runtime: Python 3.10+
- Backends: MongoDB, MySQL, SQLite, PostgreSQL, local (local disk)
- License: MIT

## When to use it

- One codebase against several databases (MongoDB in dev, PostgreSQL in prod, or per tenant)
- Nested / relational reads without writing `$lookup` or JOINs
- FastAPI services, admin backends and internal CRUD APIs with schema-driven models
- Row-level and field-level access control (role whitelists, `creator` ownership, owner-condition injection)
- Multi-tenant SaaS (schema bound to `{ source, database, schema, collection }`, runtime route override)
- Migrating between MongoDB and SQL while keeping one query syntax
- AI / natural-language data-QA layers (plan-only `build_pipeline()`, deterministic command JSON, structured feedback events)

## Concepts

- [GQL tree syntax](https://github.com/coenddt/py-store#gql-语法): `Model($condition:@c0,$sort:@s1,$limit:@l){ field, Relation{ f } }`
- [Aggregation](https://github.com/coenddt/py-store#聚合): root-level `$group` / `$having`, relation aggregate predicates (semi/anti-join), relation-rolling computed columns
- [Query & write API](https://github.com/coenddt/py-store#查询与写入-api): `query`, `query_one`, `query_with_count`, `insert`, `update`, `remove`, `mutation`, `upsert`
- [Permissions](https://github.com/coenddt/py-store#权限上下文): `set_context`, `run_as_internal`, fail-secure `set_require_context(True)`
- [Multi-datasource & multi-tenant](https://github.com/coenddt/py-store#多数据源连接): `{ source, database, schema, collection }` and route override
- [Schema reference](https://github.com/coenddt/py-store#schema-参考): fields, relations, computes, indexes, read/write whitelists
- [Vector search](https://github.com/coenddt/py-store#向量检索): `vector` fields, `$near`, `_score`, `capabilities()`, `reindex_vectors`
- [Feedback events](https://github.com/coenddt/py-store#反馈事件): `set_feedback_sink`, `PushdownUnsupportedError`
- [Transactions](https://github.com/coenddt/py-store#事务边界): per-source atomicity guarantees

## Optional

- [nodejs-store (Node.js twin)](https://github.com/coenddt/nodejs-store) ([Gitee](https://gitee.com/coenddt/nodejs-store)): same schemas, same GQL, camelCase API
- [rust-store (shared Rust core)](https://github.com/coenddt/rust-store) ([Gitee](https://gitee.com/coenddt/rust-store)): GQL parsing, permissions, computed columns, command planning, SQL dialect translation
